BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-threedecision
BundleInfo.Author: threedecision Team
BundleInfo.Synopsis: ChimeraX plugin for Discngine 3decision molecular structure database
BundleInfo.Description: A ChimeraX plugin that provides seamless integration with Discngine 3decision services, allowing users to search, download, and visualize molecular structures directly within ChimeraX. Features include structure search, project navigation, and secure credential management.
